intro: Brutal Hauberk marks the culmination of an arduous rite of passage for Horde warriors in the Barrens. After gathering rare materials and proving their mettle against dangerous foes across the lands, warriors present their bounty to the reclusive smith Thun'grim Firegaze. In return, he hammers out a rugged suit of mail designed to withstand the harshest battles.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am sure you endured much hardship and shed much blood on my task, friend. Here is the product of your toil.
May you wear it well, and may you one day return here with stories of its service to you.
